text:
The team note gives ammonia, urea and creatinine as the answer. My own reading of the physiology disagrees: ammonia is a real ADP-degradation product (via AMP deaminase), but creatinine comes from creatine and phosphocreatine rather than ADP, and urea is a slow downstream product. Hypoxanthine and inosine are the purine products that most consistently rise in blood after repeated sprints, so please check the note against its source.

CONFIDENCE: 30
